entries.femaleVariant: Hodan Warsame grew up in a good family in Mogadishu, beside the Orbital Air spaceport, the largest on Earth. The corporation hired her out of law school to write its labor contracts, and she read what she was writing: people signed for years on an orbital station and never paid off the debt, because the contracts were written so nobody could. She started helping the smugglers who got people off the stations, and within a year she was running them. Then Orbital Air found out and ambushed a run. Most of her crew and passengers died, and she escaped to Night City. Orbital Air runs every spaceport, Night City's included, so she does not fly now. She works from a couch in the lobby of a Charter Hill apartment tower and finds mercs for suits fighting other suits and for people who have a problem with a corporation. She is one of those people herself. She takes no Orbital Air money, and she has never sold a job that hands a person to a corp.
If you'd rather talk in person: Charter Hill, the tower on Palm Street. The lobby, the couch by the elevators. Location attached.
